mines.mine_notes: Advanced-stage VMS gold-copper-silver project, Alto Jaurú Greenstone Belt, Mato Grosso. PFS published March 10, 2025 (Ausenco): after-tax NPV5% $984M, IRR 61.2%, avg production 141,000 AuEq oz/y over 10 years (178,000 oz/y first 5 years), initial CAPEX $248M, payback 17 months; base prices Au $2,119/oz, Cu $4.16/lb, Ag $26.89/oz. 10.6-year open-pit operation; high-grade year-1 feed 1.45 g/t Au, 0.54% Cu. Preliminary Licence granted by CONSEMA Oct 31, 2025; DFS (Ausenco Brasil) underway, targeting Q4 2026. Corporate agreement with Aurubis AG (May 2025) for concentrate offtake optimization. No production. Option agreement gives 100% financial benefit (milestone payments). FY2025 financials: net loss $17.0M; cash $41.7M (Dec 31, 2025).
mines.ownership_pct_note: Option agreement provides 100% financial benefit; staged milestone payments to vendors (paid $1.648M of $1.75M third instalment; fifth $1.85M + shares due after positive feasibility)

mines.mine_notes: Second higher-grade VMS asset within Cabaçal belt, Mato Grosso. Exploration stage; part of Cabaçal Agreement (1.5% NSR to vendors). Inaugural resource estimate published Jan 20, 2026 with effective date Dec 31, 2025 (figures not extracted here). 2025 drilling: CD-651 returned 33.4 m @ 2.0 g/t AuEq; CD-655 returned 9.9 m @ 5.6 g/t AuEq.
